name: argus
description: Browser fingerprinting library for fraud and bot detection

scripts.build:vm: npm run compile:vm && BUILD=vm rollup --config rollup.config.mjs
scripts.build:loader: ARGUS_IFRAME_INTEGRITY=$(node scripts/worker-sri.mjs dist/argus-integrity-iframe.iife.js) BUILD=loader rollup --config rollup.config.mjs
scripts.build:iframe: npm run compile:vm && npm run build:worker && ARGUS_WORKER_INTEGRITY=$(node scripts/worker-sri.mjs dist/argus-integrity-worker.iife.js) BUILD=iframe rollup --config rollup.config.mjs
scripts.build:worker: npm run compile:vm && BUILD=worker rollup --config rollup.config.mjs
scripts.build:prod: rm -rf dist && npm run compile:vm && BUILD=prod rollup --config rollup.config.mjs && BUILD=worker rollup --config rollup.config.mjs && ARGUS_WORKER_INTEGRITY=$(node scripts/worker-sri.mjs dist/argus-integrity-worker.iife.js) BUILD=iframe rollup --config rollup.config.mjs && npm run build:loader && npm run build:bootstrap && node scripts/write-sri-manifest.mjs dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build:prod && npx cdk deploy ms-argus-web-dev-jw
scripts.deploy:e2e: ARGUS_STAGE=e2e ARGUS_API_STAGE=dev-jw npm run build:prod && npx cdk deploy ms-argus-web-e2e --require-approval never
scripts.build:demo: npm run build && npm run build:css && cp public/index.html public/styles.css public/simple.html dist/
scripts.minify: javascript-obfuscator dist/argus.esm.js --output dist/argus.esm.min.js --compact true --simplify false --string-array false --identifier-names-generator hexadecimal --source-map true
scripts.quality: npm run lint:test && npm run deps && npm run dead-code && npm run duplication
scripts.serve:demo: npm run build:demo && npx http-server dist -p 8080 -c-1 --cors
